tools.name: generate_barcode
tools.description: Draw a barcode or QR code and return it as SVG (for print) and as a PNG preview. format: EAN13, EAN8, UPC (UPC-A), ITF14, CODE128, CODE39 or QR. value: the digits or text (QR: any text or URL up to 256 characters). Colours as #rrggbb; keep the bars dark on a light background so scanners can read it.

tools.name: check_barcode_number
tools.description: For EAN13, EAN8, UPC or ITF14: give the full number to check its check digit, or the number without the last digit to get the check digit and the full number.
